source_policy: Generate directly from original screenshots; never use earlier generated posters as references.

posters.prompt: Landscape 16:9. Pristine warm white editorial launch composition. Huge AniShelf upper left, exact headline '把热爱，收藏成宇宙。' in 2 lines left; small subtitle '电影 · 剧集 · 动漫 · 书籍'. On right and lower area show three RECTANGULAR FRAMELESS app screenshot panels in native aspect ratios: original Mac screenshot is wide and upper back layer, original iPad screenshot is WIDE LANDSCAPE 4:3 at lower right, original iPhone screenshot is TALL 1:2.17 in foreground left of other panels. Absolutely NO hardware frame, no laptop or tablet bezel, no physical device, no black device edge, no perspective or stretching. Treat screenshots like museum mounted prints with subtle shadows and rounded corners only. Preserve screen aspect ratios exactly. Macro UI clear enough; crop Mac desktop around application. Small bottom caption '为 13 英寸 iPad 与 iPhone Air 设计' and 'Mac 现阶段有限支持'. Background just ivory paper with one thin lilac line. Elegant typographic negative space, no flower decorations.

PORTRAIT 2:3 poster. Radical close-up editorial composition: deep midnight navy background, ice-blue Chinese text in LEFT top, big stacked exact headline '好奇，\n没有终点。' small subtitle '从作品，探索角色与创作者'. Small AniShelf wordmark bottom left. The supplied original landscape iPad screenshot shows cast and creative staff. Make a very LARGE landscape tablet whose LEFT and BOTTOM portions extend beyond canvas, positioned lower-right with a slight realistic perspective. The visible screen focuses tightly on the original sheet cast portraits, creator names and related works, enough readability. Device should occupy 75% area and crop off canvas, not a whole tiny tablet floating in center. A single thin pale blue orbital curved line goes behind the tablet (outside screen), suggesting discovery. No stars, no rainbow gradients, no glow blobs, no invented UI. Premium magazine cover. Big type with varied line widths and clean editorial tension.

Portrait 2:3. Clean white top 35%, vivid lemon yellow lower65%. Huge black typography upper left exact '读懂，\n再入迷。'. Small right subtitle 'AI 翻译简介 · 查找中文译名'. Tiny AniShelf brand. Main visual: FRAMELESS FLAT rectangular CROP of the supplied original detail sheet, tightly extract the synopsis from screenshot, exclude surrounding tablet home and library. Flat 2D crop panel fills lower area, extends past right canvas edge, large readable original Chinese text. No physical device, no bezel, no phone, no tablet, no perspective. Use only real synopsis UI as content with original typography, do not create new before-after UI. A small original season tab strip above synopsis shows exploration context. Restrained asymmetric editorial poster with hard geometry and slight paper shadow.

PORTRAIT 2:3 poster. Ultra-clean GRAPHITE BLACK background with vivid electric cobalt side stripe. Exact white headline upper-left '不同平台，\n同一部热爱。', small subtitle '全平台 AI 关联'. Use supplied original phone platform-association screenshot as a sharp screen insert: giant phone positioned far RIGHT with right 25% of phone deliberately cropped outside canvas, its vertical platform cards dominate. On LEFT in bottom half, elegant vertically stacked typeset service names 'TMDB' 'Trakt' 'AniList' 'Bangumi' 'MyAnimeList', each on separate line with restrained thin connector lines ending at device edge, outside screenshot. Small AniShelf top-left. Typography aligned to an exact modular grid, generous black negative space. Background flat graphite with subtle material grain, no pastel, no soft gradients. Do not invent platform cards or put additional cards inside screenshot; full service names outside are marketing type. Powerful data-connection visual.

Portrait 2:3. Warm rich coral paper background. Large burgundy exact headline BOTTOM LEFT '每份热爱，\n都有进度。', small subtitle '评分 · 追番 · 阅读 · 跨平台同步'. Tiny AniShelf top-left. Main visual upper 65% is a FRAMELESS FLAT native 4:3 iPad library screenshot panel from image1, overscaled and extending beyond canvas right edge. Foreground mid-left a FRAMELESS rectangular exact crop of score/progress/season UI from image2, subtle shadow, cropped behind the headline. These are screenshots printed on panels, not hardware. NO black bezels, no phone or tablet frames, no fake small device, no perspective deformation, preserve source aspect ratios. Use real poster grid and actual UI text. Bold lively but minimal graphic design with carefully chosen overlap, not a cluttered collage.

Portrait 2:3. Pitch black cinematic background. Large ivory headline upper-left exact '看到哪里，\n接着就好。', small footer 'Trakt 观看进度 · 最近观看', small AniShelf top-left. Huge dark gray S02 and E08 typographic motif behind main visual at low contrast. Main visual is a perfectly FLAT FRAMELESS rectangular macro crop of the recent-watching section of the ORIGINAL screenshot. Show all 3 actual poster cards and season/episode text prominently in a HORIZONTAL strip, centered across lower-middle and extending slightly off both side edges. No phone hardware, no device outline, no bezels, no curved or bent screen, no perspective. The original source recent-watching row is the ONLY screen content; remove top home banner and bottom tab bar by cropping only. Do not paint over posters or invent characters, use the actual screenshot insert. Short restrained red-orange rule above footer. Premium editorial typography, massive black negative space around image.

Portrait 2:3. Deep aubergine black with restrained amber edge light and elegant warm cream type. Top small 'AniShelf × Infuse'. Huge expressive Chinese serif exact headline '天作之合。', below '在 AniShelf 探索，让 Infuse 接续观影'. Main visual is a FRAMELESS FLAT RECTANGULAR crop of ORIGINAL image1 containing Yuru Camp artwork, title and actual purple Infuse button, fills center and extends off RIGHT edge. Near bottom-left a secondary SMALLER frameless crop from original image2 showing episode title and its Infuse button, crop only actual sheet content. Keep layout sparse, two focal UI extracts only. NO hardware devices, no phone outline, no tablet, no bezels, no fake playback screen. Absolutely straight rectangular panels, subtle depth by shadow only, faithful original colors and text. Large headline should be clear above image without crowding. Minimal luxurious cinematic partnership-like concept without claiming official endorsement.

PORTRAIT 2:3 poster. A sophisticated TWO-TONE graphic background divided diagonally: warm oat-gold upper-left and cool periwinkle lower-right, derived from supplied screenshots. No white background. Bold charcoal exact Chinese headline upper-left '一镜到底。' and second line lower-right '色随故事。' in larger spaced characters, headline placement frames image rather than identical top caption. Small subtitle near bottom '智能取色 · 为液态玻璃设计', small AniShelf upper-left. Two huge original phone screen crops, image 1 golden manga details on LEFT and image 2 lavender anime details on RIGHT, staggered vertically and overlapping slightly at center. Device top and bottom edges extend outside canvas, show only 2/3 of each phone so REAL hero art, translucent navigation and themed surfaces fill visual. The screenshot colors must remain original; no recoloring. Focus on real app material and harmony. A tiny thin line separating warm/cool background, premium art-direction design, strong geometry, no generic floating glass spheres, no extra icons, no repeating campaign frame.
